department: Department of BioSciences (Biochemistry and Cell Biology)

deadline.value: Applications by December 1, 2026 get early evaluation; the final deadline is December 31, 2026.
deadline.quote: Applications submitted by December 1 will be prioritized for early evaluation. | The application deadline is December 31.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional and applicants who skip them are not at a disadvantage.
gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE scores is optional for applicants to the BCB program.

gre_subject.value: Subject tests are not required, but a high score in a relevant field helps.
gre_subject.quote: GRE subject-matter tests are not required, but a high score on a subject test in a relevant field will strengthen your application.

supervisor.value: Applications go to the program and its committee, not to a specific faculty member.
supervisor.quote: Applications are made to the departmental graduate program and not to a specific faculty member or professor.

funding.value: Incoming students without an external fellowship get a fellowship with full tuition waiver and stipend for the first year; admission includes a research stipend.
funding.quote: Admission to the graduate program includes a research stipend.

also.quote: Incoming students who do not hold external fellowships will be awarded a Biochemistry & Cell Biology Graduate Fellowship for their first year of study comprised of a full tuition waiver and a stipend to cover living expenses.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a master's degree is needed.

notes: Systems, Synthetic and Physical Biology is a separate interdisciplinary PhD program not saved here.
